source.name: Resume photo is not a regulated format — small 2-inch (33×48 mm) is the common convention

notes.zh: 简历无官方规格；小二寸（33×48mm）白底为通用惯例，蓝底亦常见；透明底 PNG 便于嵌入设计模板。
notes.en: No official standard; small 2-inch white background is the convention, blue also common; transparent PNG fits resume templates.
